newsitem.title: USA: Interactive Buyers names Thomure as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Interactive Buyers names Thomure as CEO.

text.p: Interactive Buyers Network International Ltd said Tuesday it has appointed Joseph Thomure as chief executive officer and Samuel Bradt as chief financial officer as part of a broad restructuring.
Details of who they replace were not immediately available.
Michael Hastings remains as president of the firm.
Thomure has worked since July at BSi, a unit of Interactive, and has helped BSi to start generating revenues.

The company said in a statement that new executives will personally invest about $300,000 as a part of this restructuring and plan to raise additional capital following the closing of the transaction.

As part of the restructuring, founding shareholders are contributing 1,050,000 presently outstanding common shares back to the company, and canceling all existing options and certificates of contingent interest.
After the restructuring the group of investors led by Thomure will hold 50 percent of Interactive's outstanding shares.
